name: 2-amino-3-(6-chloro-1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid
notes: 6-chloro-L-tryptophan: non-proteinogenic amino acid with indole ring. Dual label correct.

name: prochaetoglobosin I
notes: Cytochalasan alkaloid from PKS-NRPS hybrid biosynthesis. Should also be labeled Polyketide.

name: 6-Methyl-DL-tryptophan
notes: Methylated tryptophan derivative; retains alpha-amino acid backbone + indole ring.

name: 5-Ethenyl-L-tryptophan
notes: Vinyl-substituted tryptophan; intact amino acid backbone + indole.

name: 5-Ethynyl-1.2-dimethyltryptophan
notes: Alkynyl dimethyl tryptophan analog; amino acid backbone + N-methylated indole.

name: Albendazole
notes: Synthetic benzimidazole anthelmintic drug (methyl 5-(propylthio)-2-benzimidazolecarbamate). Not a natural product alkaloid.

name: 1H-1,2,3-Triazole-1-acetic acid macrolactone
notes: Synthetic compound with 1,2,3-triazole (click chemistry product) + macrolactone. Triazoles are not natural products. Not a true alkaloid or polyketide.

name: 2-amino-3-(7-chloro-2-methyl-1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid
notes: 7-chloro-2-methyltryptophan: non-proteinogenic amino acid with indole ring.

name: 4.4'-dipyridyl disulfide
notes: Synthetic disulfide reagent (Aldrithiol-4) used for thiol detection. Not a natural alkaloid.

name: alpha-Amino-7-chloro-1.2-dimethyl-1H-indole-3-propanal
notes: Synthetic chlorinated dimethylindole propanal; indole alkaloid scaffold classification is reasonable for this N-containing heterocycle.

name: EAS
notes: Synthetic chloroindole-piperidine compound (bis-chloroindole linked via piperidine + amino acid fragment). Designed pharmaceutical; not a natural alkaloid.

name: 2-Methyl-6-(4-morpholinyl)tryptophan
notes: Morpholine-substituted methyltryptophan; retains amino acid backbone + indole ring.

name: alpha-4-Diamino-1.2-dimethyl-1H-indole-3-propanal
notes: Aminoindole propanal derivative; indole alkaloid scaffold.

name: alpha-Amino-4-fluoro-1.2-dimethyl-1H-indole-3-propanal
notes: Fluorinated dimethylindole propanal; indole alkaloid scaffold.

name: Fumitremorgin C
notes: Prenylated indole diketopiperazine alkaloid from L-Trp + L-Pro. Dual label correct.

name: 4-(aminobutylamino)pyridine
notes: Simple synthetic pyridine with aminobutyl chain. Not a recognized natural alkaloid.

name: (R)-norreticuline
notes: Benzylisoquinoline alkaloid; key intermediate in BIA biosynthesis pathway.

name: 4-Bromotryptophan
notes: Halogenated tryptophan found in marine natural products. Amino acid + indole ring.

name: Buspirone
notes: Synthetic azapirone anxiolytic drug. Not a natural product alkaloid.

name: tropinone
notes: Tropane alkaloid; central intermediate in tropane alkaloid biosynthesis from ornithine.

name: synthetic benzimidazolone-piperidine
notes: Synthetic pharmaceutical compound with benzimidazolone-guanidine-piperidine scaffold. Not a natural alkaloid.

name: campesine B
notes: Fungal indole piperazine alkaloid from genome mining. Novel 8-ring scaffold.

name: (R)-N-Methylcoclaurine
notes: Benzylisoquinoline alkaloid; key intermediate in BIA pathway to reticuline and morphine.

name: bispyribac sodium
notes: Synthetic pyrimidinylthiobenzoate herbicide (ALS inhibitor). Not a natural product.

name: Benzoic acid triazolyl macrolactone
notes: Synthetic compound with 1.2.3-triazole (click chemistry) + macrolactone + benzoate. Not a natural alkaloid.

name: 4-fluoro-2.1-dimethyltryptophan
notes: Fluorinated dimethyltryptophan; retains amino acid backbone + indole ring.

name: Lidocaine
notes: Synthetic amide local anesthetic (2-diethylamino-N-(2.6-dimethylphenyl)acetamide). First synthesized 1935. Not a natural alkaloid.

name: synthetic benzoxazine
notes: Efavirenz-like synthetic benzoxazine with trifluoromethyl and cyclopropylalkynyl groups. Synthetic HIV drug scaffold. Not a natural alkaloid.

name: alpha-Amino-4-hydroxy-1.2-dimethyl-1H-indole-3-propanal
notes: Hydroxylated dimethylindole propanal; indole alkaloid scaffold.

name: campesine C
notes: Fungal indole piperazine alkaloid; N-acetylated campesine variant.

name: cyclo(Tyr-Phe) DKP
notes: Diketopiperazine cyclic dipeptide from Tyr + Phe. Natural product from Bacillus spp. DKP alkaloid + amino acid origin.

name: (E)-(Indol-3-yl)acetaldehyde oxime
notes: Indole-3-acetaldoxime; tryptophan-derived plant metabolite in auxin/glucosinolate biosynthesis. Indole alkaloid pathway intermediate.

name: cotinine
notes: Pyridine alkaloid; major metabolite of nicotine. Found naturally in tobacco.

name: Agroclavine
notes: Clavine-type ergot alkaloid with ergoline tetracyclic nucleus. Fungal natural product.

name: 6-Fluoro-2-methyl-tryptophan
notes: Fluorinated methyltryptophan; retains amino acid backbone + indole ring.

name: Phenyl 7-azabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane-7-carboxylate
notes: Synthetic nortropane (azanorbornane) carbamate derivative. Pharmaceutical scaffold not a natural alkaloid.

name: tabersonine
notes: Aspidosperma-type monoterpenoid indole alkaloid; precursor to vindoline/vinblastine.

name: hydroxylated tabersonine analog
notes: Aspidosperma indole alkaloid scaffold (vindoline pathway intermediate with C-19 hydroxyl).

name: 4-Nitro-L-tryptophan
notes: Nitro-substituted tryptophan; non-proteinogenic amino acid with indole ring.

name: alpha-Amino-1.2-dimethyl-5-phenyl-1H-indole-3-propanal
notes: Phenyl-substituted dimethylindole propanal; indole alkaloid scaffold.
